_about: One reel = one plan. Times are word refs: "w12" = start of word 12 in the words file, "w12+0.3" / "w12-0.1" offsets in seconds, or plain seconds. See SPEC.md for what each object and state looks like.
_note: Example plan, not real content: every word ref (w12 = word 12 of the words file) and time here is an example value from a 23.7 s demo take. Claude rewrites beats, objects, captions and sounds from your own words-cut.json. Keep the keys and the shape.
_footage_note: Your rough cut, written by cut.py (your raw take goes in cut.py's SRC). Words = cut.py's output too.
_duration_note: Seconds, = the length of your cut.mp4 (cut.py prints it).
_accent_note: Your ONE brand accent (from your profile). Leave it out to use BRAND_ACCENT in build.py. The hook's pale tint is mixed from it.

hook._note: line2_em = the last word of line 2, set in serif italic in your accent. 'until' = when the hook leaves.

beats.why: claim: your opening line, on your face
a big number or idea you say: type slide, you slide out
explaining: you in the box, one object above
something to read: a real page grows to full screen
new subject: back to your face
a real definition or page beside you
the payoff: an equation built from what's on screen
reconnect: your closing line, on your face

_beats_note: state = face / split / full; field = paper / sage. One change every 2-3 s (SPEC.md 'Beats').

captions._note: groups = [first word index, last word index], 2-4 words each. keywords = the exact caption words (with their punctuation) that turn accent, one per group at most.

objects._note: logos = [file name in assets/proof/ without .svg, label]. Real logos only; a missing file shows the label alone.
typewall: the big serif word + the sub lines are your exact spoken words, each on its own word ref.
Rows are your words. mark = tick / strike / none.
proof = an id from proof.json (tools/capture_proof.py writes assets/proof/<id>.png + .json). marks = phrases on that page to highlight as you say them. If the capture is missing the card is skipped.
A chapter word: the new subject in your words, carried up to a small title.
proof = an id from proof.json (tools/capture_proof.py writes assets/proof/<id>.png + .json). marks = phrases on that page to highlight as you say them. If the capture is missing the card is skipped.
logos = [file name in assets/proof/ without .svg, label]. Real logos only; a missing file shows the label alone.
Only a number you actually say. No number in your take? Delete this object.

_captions_off_note: Word ranges with no captions (a type slide already shows those words).
sounds: presenter out, sage floods in (fastest frame of the move)
list card lands as the presenter returns
_sounds_note: [file in assets/sfx/, word ref, why]. SFX aren't shipped: missing files (or files not measured in assets/sfx/peaks.txt) are skipped, and you can add sounds natively in Edits instead.
